summary: Iteration 9 (both). Backend: 80/80 tests pass (10 new iter9 tests + 70 regression, 21.3s). New EventIn.time_start/time_end/people, StaffShift.time_start/time_end round-trip cleanly; /api/expenses full CRUD works (auth-required, owner-scoped, year+month & year-only filtering); /api/stats now returns company_expenses and profit = revenue - total_cost - company_expenses in both monthly and yearly modes. Frontend: fixed a blocking SyntaxError in /app/frontend/app/event/[id].tsx (stray/duplicate closing StyleSheet garbage at lines 665-684 corrupted the file — web + native bundle both returned 500). After fix bundle builds green and app loads. Verified: 6-tab bottom bar (Kalendarz, Imprezy, Oferta, Koszty, Pracownicy, Statystyki) fits and labels are readable on 390px viewport. Koszty screen: month navigator + summary card + FAB + add-expense modal all work; created 'TEST_UI_Prąd 500 zł' on 2026-08-05 and it appeared in the list ('Suma kosztów miesiąca 500,00 zł · 1 pozycji'). Statystyki (Aug 2026): 'Firmowe (najem, media itp.) 500,00 zł' row visible in Podział kosztów and monthly Zysk = -500,00 zł (0 imprez); yearly 2026 card shows Zysk 11 250,00 zł (previously 11 750, i.e. reduced by 500 as expected). Delete expense also works. CRITICAL BUG (blocking): opening the event editor (tap any existing event) throws a red-screen ReferenceError: 'pricing is not defined' at app/event/[id].tsx:309 — the JSX references a `pricing` variable that is imported as `computePricing` from '@/src/pricing' but the useMemo/binding that produces `pricing` was never added. This makes ALL event editing screens crash on both new (+ Dodaj imprezę) and existing (tap event card) flows, so I could NOT verify: (a) 'Miejsce' input removed, (b) 'Godzina od' + 'Godzina do' fields, (c) 'Liczba osób' input & pricing card breakdown (birthday packages / warsztaty), (d) shift auto-compute hours from time_start+time_end (incl. overnight 22→02=4h), (e) compact time format '18–22' on Imprezy cards for new-style events. Existing legacy events on Imprezy still show old 'time' field (e.g. 'Party 22:00 · 22:00', 'Wesele · 18:00') — expected since they have no time_start/time_end. All non-editor flows (login, calendar, tab bar, koszty, stats, oferta) work fine.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: 'pricing is not defined' at line 309 crashes the entire event editor screen (red screen for user). `pricing` is referenced in JSX (rows 309-320) but never declared. `computePricing` is imported from '@/src/pricing' — add `const pricing = useMemo(() => computePricing({ category, date, people: Number(people) || 0 }), [category, date, people]);` (or equivalent) before the JSX. Blocks entire event CRUD.
Because editor crashes, could not verify 'Miejsce' removal / Godzina od / Godzina do / Liczba osób inputs and per-shift time_start/time_end auto-hours computation.

integration_issues.issue: Editor unreachable due to pricing ReferenceError — cannot exercise POST/PUT /api/events with new fields from the UI (though backend accepts them fine, verified via pytest).

issues: All 6 tab labels fit but 'Pracownicy' is 9 chars — tab item width is tight; visually acceptable but any font-size increase would clip. Labels render at 11px which is at the readability floor for older users.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add the missing `pricing` binding in /app/frontend/app/event/[id].tsx (before line 309). Example: `const pricing = useMemo(() => computePricing({ category, date, people: Number(people)||0 }), [category, date, people]);`. Ensure it returns null/undefined for categories with no pricing table so the conditional `{pricing && (...)}` still short-circuits.

After the fix, re-verify: (a) tapping 'Dorośli · Okolicznościowe' Wesele opens editor without red-screen; (b) creating a new event with category 'dzieci/urodzinki/standard', date on a Saturday (e.g. 2026-08-08) and 25 people shows pricing card 'STANDARD (Pt–Nd) · baza 1450 + 5 × 40 zł = 1650 zł' with Zastosuj badge; (c) category 'dzieci/wycieczki' + 15 people shows '15 × 90 zł = 1350 zł'; (d) shift row with time_start='18:00' + time_end='22:00' auto-fills hours=4; overnight 22:00→02:00 = 4; (e) Imprezy card for the new event shows compact '18–22' (no minutes) or '18:30–22:00' (with minutes).

Verify main agent left no other truncated files after the multi-file edit — the corrupt EOF in event/[id].tsx (lines 665-684 stray duplicate StyleSheet fragments) suggests a bad copy/paste. I removed those lines but suggest reviewing recent diffs on kalendarz.tsx/imprezy.tsx/statystyki.tsx just in case.

rca_of_issue: Two issues found. (1) SyntaxError blocking whole bundle: /app/frontend/app/event/[id].tsx had 20 stray/corrupted lines appended after the terminating `});` — looked like a partial paste of a StyleSheet fragment (starting with 'undColor: ...'). Root cause is almost certainly a botched multi-line search/replace by the main agent when adding the new pricing / people / time_start / time_end UI. Reproduced by curl on the platform=web bundle (HTTP 500 with 'SyntaxError: Unexpected token (666:2)') and the equivalent android/ios bundles. Mitigation applied: trimmed file to a single clean `});` at line 664; verified `curl` on bundle returns 200 and app loads. (2) ReferenceError in event editor: `pricing` is used in JSX at line 309 but never declared. `computePricing` is imported but the memo/call that produces `pricing` is missing. Not fixed here (business-logic — need to know exact input shape). Suggested fix in action_items. Main agent should also add a fallback so the pricingCard hides gracefully when the category has no auto-price.
